tasks.title: adsr counts AD on frames where both sides are gated off, which is structurally unhearable
tasks.verify: `adsr` compares the whole 16-bit pair on every frame, including frames where BOTH sides are gated off -- where AD governs nothing and both players reload it from the instrument before the next gate-on (patterns.py:389-393 states this, citing gplay.c:397-398 and player.s:882-892). On 5_Title_Tunes that is 1870 of 3743 disagreeing frames: half the column's deficit cannot be heard.
